text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1864506789 - P2 - Mistral (enterprise, VPC) degraded in eu-west. Latency and 5xx spikes from tenant-dedicated pool. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Paging acknowledged. I'm digging. seeing elevated 5xx from pods on pool-mistral-eu-west-04, kernel OOMs in nodes? attaching logs.

anna-sre: can you confirm it's limited to dedicated pool for Mistral and not shared?

sre-oncall: yes, confirmed via routing logs and tenant tags — traffic stays in the dedicated pool. other tenants healthy.

mistral-sre: Thanks for the heads up. Mistral reports increased error rates from our side too. We're on standby.

eng-oncall: any immediate mitigation plan? Do we want to shift traffic to eu-central warm pool?

sre-oncall: proposing warm failover to eu-central-dedicated-warm-02. We currently have warm capacity reserved for Mistral but need to validate KV cache compatibility and DNS TTL.

lina-platform: I'm available to do the traffic drain + DNS step. Checklist: 1) mark eu-west nodes as draining for pool-mistral 2) spin up any missing warm servers in eu-central 3) switch routing policy for Mistral to prefer eu-central 4) shorten DNS TTL and update CNAMEs 5) monitor.

matt-pd: Notify Mistral SRE and Sales ops. Customer-facing note ready?

mistral-sre: yes, we've prepared a short note: "We are seeing elevated errors in eu-west. We will shift traffic to eu-central as a temporary mitigation. Expect ~30s interruption during DNS switchover." Send me updates and ETA.

sre-oncall: starting drain now. Command: 

```bash
# cordon + drain nodes serving pool-mistral-eu-west-04
kubectl cordon node-ew-04a && kubectl drain node-ew-04a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

deploy-bot: deploy job #deploy-1864 started on eu-central-warm-02 (ami-rl-67c).

anna-sre: observed graceful connections finishing. traffic from pool decreased 45% in 2m.

sre-oncall: warm capacity check: ✅ eu-central-dedicated-warm-02 at 85% ready. KV snapshot compatibility verified for model shard sets.

lina-platform: preparing DNS change. Current CNAME for mistral-api.mistral.com -> mistral-eu-west.redwood-inference.net. We'll flip to mistral-eu-central.redwood-inference.net and reduce TTL from 60 to 10 before swap. Command (internal DNS):

```text
gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=redwood-internal
gcloud dns record-sets transaction remove --name=mistral-api.mistral.com. --ttl=60 --type=CNAME 
# add new low ttl record
gcloud dns record-sets transaction add --name=mistral-api.mistral.com. --ttl=10 --type=CNAME mistral-eu-central.redwood-inference.net.
gcloud dns record-sets transaction execute --zone=redwood-internal
```

mistral-sre: set. We're ready to accept connection migration. Do we want to run gradual traffic shift via smart routing to minimize cache misses?

sre-oncall: yes, enable smart routing weight shift: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 minute windows. If errors spike >2x baseline, rollback to eu-west.

eng-oncall: adding the routing policy change:

```yaml
# routing policy patch (internal)
- route: mistral
  weights:
    eu-west: 0.8
    eu-central: 0.2
```

sre-oncall: applied 20/80 now. Metrics: errors down 30% for Mistral, latency slightly up (+40ms). Continuing to 50/50 in 3m.

(3 minutes later)

sre-oncall: moved to 50/50. Errors stable. Proceeding to 100% in 3m.

lina-platform: DNS TTL is 10. Executing final DNS flip to make eu-central canonical.

```text
gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=redwood-internal
gcloud dns record-sets transaction remove --name=mistral-api.mistral.com. --ttl=10 --type=CNAME mistral-eu-west.redwood-inference.net.
gcloud dns record-sets transaction add --name=mistral-api.mistral.com. --ttl=10 --type=CNAME mistral-eu-central.redwood-inference.net.
gcloud dns record-sets transaction execute --zone=redwood-internal
```

deploy-bot: DNS change executed at 1864507410.

anna-sre: monitoring DNS propagation and connection metrics. Most clients respect the TTL; a few long-lived connections still hitting eu-west but overall traffic >90% in eu-central now.

mistral-sre: customer reports nominal traffic and successful requests. They see brief retries but no service outage. Thank you.

sre-oncall: we're keeping eu-west pool cordoned and will leave for 1h before full maintenance teardown. Opening a follow-up ticket to investigate node OOMs and kernel logs.

matt-pd: I'll send the customer update summarizing actions and planned postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1864506789 status -> mitigated. P2 -> monitoring.

lina-platform: handoff to on-call for follow-up: @anna-sre you'll own post-incident investigation. @matt-pd please coordinate the customer comms.

anna-sre: acknowledged, taking post-incident. I'll collect logs, heap profiles, and file a root-cause with timeline.

sre-oncall: thanks team. Closing this incident thread; will update ticket with RCA link once available. :thumbsup:
